title: Webhooks connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One webhook connector instance's settings: which provider's signature scheme to verify, the header the signature arrives in, and the timestamp tolerance a replay check allows. The listener is ingest's own loopback route POST /v1/namespaces/{ns}/fabric/webhooks/{instance} (D111, §33 §2.2's remote-ingress note), so the path is derived from the instance and is not configured here. `hmac.secret` resolves through the namespace's secret store (D189) and is exactly the manifest's `secrets` list.

verification.description: The signature scheme (CN1 Task 4: hmac-sha256, github, stripe, slack, shopify). A failed signature is a 401 and a counter.

hmac.description: HMAC material, for the hmac-sha256 scheme and for the provider schemes' shared secret.

secret.description: The shared secret the signature is computed over. Resolved through the secret store (D189); never stored in the instance.

signature_header.description: The header the signature arrives in. Each scheme has its provider's default (X-Hub-Signature-256, Stripe-Signature, X-Slack-Signature, X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256), so this only overrides them (CN1 Task 4).

timestamp_header.description: The header carrying the signed timestamp, for the schemes that sign one (Slack's X-Slack-Request-Timestamp).

timestamp_tolerance_secs.description: How old a signed request may be before it is refused as a replay. CN1 Task 4 sets 300 s for Stripe.

delivery_id_header.description: The header carrying the provider's delivery id, which becomes the CloudEvent id and the replay dedup key (CN1 Task 4: the provider's delivery id header where one exists, else SHA-256 of the body and timestamp).

api_key_header.description: The header an opaque API key arrives in, for the `key` auth slug on a provider that has no signature.
